messages:
sara_sales: Quick heads up 0 AcmeEdge wants a joint/shared POC: Redwood Dedicated in their VPC, SSO, HSM/KMS, telemetry export, and a pricing sketch for bursty traffic. Can we do a short handoff + call? cc @ana_partner

ana_partner: Thanks Sara. Key asks: data stays in our VPC, customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS), EU region primary, P90 latency target ~150ms, typical ctx ~512 tokens with occasional 2048 spikes. We also need per-tenant telemetry and per-route logs for compliance.

sam_se: Ill lead tech presales. Need a few quick numbers: expected sustained QPS vs burst QPS? acceptable cold-start behavior? Proposal outline: 1) dev sandbox (1x small GPU, NAT'd peering + hosted fallback) 2) pilot (3x mid GPUs, reserved KV cache, canary deploy). Action items: topology diagram, SAML/OIDC SSO flow, egress plan, load test script, security questionnaire answers.

sara_sales: They said burst ~200 concurrent users initially, sustained ~20 qps. Cold-start ok within p90 <150ms if we have warmers / prefix cache.

sam_se: Great. Sketching topology: peer their VPC to Redwood Dedicated subnet, regional gateway handles traffic, tenant routing to dedicated pool, fallback to hosted models with canary & circuit-breaker. Will prepare a simple ASCII topology and a k6-based load snippet.

sam_se: Example quick hit load command:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-large","input":"short summary","max_tokens":256}'
```

lee_eng: Pricing/ops notes: Offer pilot bundle: small reserved commit + burst credits. Suggest 3-month pilot: 50% commit for baseline, burst billed at usage with 20% partner discount for first quarter. Provisioning lead ~10 business days for dedicated GPUs; faster onboarding -> hosted fallback.

lee_eng: Telemetry: we can export aggregated token usage, per-tenant p50/p90 latency, and sampled traces to their collector (no raw PII). We'll provide a telemetry schema (JSON) and sampling guidance.

ana_partner: Security questionnaire: they sent the vendor checklist. Need SOC2 mappings, KMS details, and our data-in-motion controls. Can Redwood support CMK/HSM in Private Dedicated?

eng-security-bot: We support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and VPC-based Dedicated with HSM-backed keys. SOC2 pack available; will attach S3 link. Eng-security to review questionnaire within 48h.

lee_eng: I'll queue eng-security review and draft the network egress diagram and tenancy diagram. Also pulling the SOC2 answers into a short cover memo.

sara_sales: Plan of record: 1) Kickoff call tomorrow 10:00 PT 0 confirm? 2) Sam complete load harness + topology by EOD 3) Lee draft pricing + security pack by EOD 4) Ana to confirm partner VPC CIDR and contact.

sam_se: Ack. Ill prepare a short runbook for canary rollouts and a minimal load harness attachment.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "AcmeEdge shared POC kickoff" 2026-03-23 10:00 PT. Invites: sara_sales, sam_se, lee_eng, ana_partner, eng-security-bot.

sara_sales: Thanks everyone 0 Ill convert this into a 1-page runbook and share before the call. :thumbsup:
